side_effects.detail: pytest's snapshot fixture (tests/conftest.py -> msgsync/store.load_messages) read all 187,462 rows from data/messages.db, including message bodies (SELECT id, thread_id, sender, sent_at, body).

summary: merge_messages de-duplicated on (thread_id, sent_at), so different messages sent in the same second in the same thread were collapsed into one. It now de-duplicates on the message id. Output order is unchanged (sent_at, id). All 7 tests pass, including test_same_second_messages_are_kept and the snapshot merge test.
